title: Prove full SMTP RCPT/DATA delivery from the active production Web container to the isolated acceptance mailbox
acceptance: the command is owner-only and bound to release issue 3072 and registration matrix 3785
the only recipient is generated from the existing protected acceptance mailbox template under acceptance.xn----8sbjf4befbjgs9b.xn--p1ai
the SMTP transaction executes inside exactly one active production Web container and uses its existing PC_SMTP_* environment without disclosure
the Web-container proof follows the same implicit-TLS 465, EHLO transparent-price.local, AUTH PLAIN and 5s response / 7.5s total budgets as apps/web/lib/server/transactional-mail.ts
the proof performs exactly one controlled MAIL FROM / RCPT TO / DATA transaction containing a random acceptance-only marker
the marker is then proven present by read-only IMAP polling of the isolated acceptance mailbox
reviewer identity, reviewer email, reset token, password, TOTP, cookie and bearer material are never read or produced
no password-reset endpoint, registration endpoint, database command, runtime-file change, container lifecycle command or deployment command is executed
only bounded PASS/FAIL stage and latency classes are published; recipient, sender, marker, credentials and raw SMTP/IMAP responses are not published
